title: Patience Finds the Hidden Ledger

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Look, Wren, the meadow whispers a secret waiting patiently!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: I hear a soft hum, like a quiet heartbeat.

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: If we stay still, maybe the clue will appear!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Patience is like a gentle breeze guiding us forward.

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: The ledger glows brighter when we wait together quietly.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Our calm hearts make the meadow sing softly tonight.
